info.name: TravelBestie Manager API
info.description:
Complete test collection for the TravelBestie Manager REST API.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` (default: `http://localhost:3000`)
2. Adjust `testUserEmail`, `testUserPassword`, `testUserName` if needed
3. **Optional — production only**: set `rsaPublicKeyBase64` (SPKI, base64, no PEM headers) to enable RSA-OAEP encryption for auth requests

## Dev vs production mode
**Dev (no `rsaPublicKeyBase64` set):** auth requests send plaintext body fields directly. The server accepts them when `RSA_PRIVATE_KEY` env var is absent.
**Production (`rsaPublicKeyBase64` set):** pre-request scripts encrypt credentials with RSA-OAEP + SHA-256 before sending. Requires Postman v10+.

## Run order
`token` and `tripId` are saved automatically. Run Auth → Trips → Comments → Karma for the full happy path.

item.name: Register - Missing encryptedPayload [prod only]
item.description: In dev mode (no RSA_PRIVATE_KEY on server) the decryption step is bypassed, so the 400 comes from validate() catching missing fields instead. In production the error is 'encryptedPayload is required'.

exec: // In production mode the exact error is 'encryptedPayload is required'
pm.test('Error is encryptedPayload required [prod]', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.equal('encryptedPayload is required'));

item.name: Delete Trip - Success
item.description: Deletes the trip saved in {{tripId}}. Run this LAST in the Trips folder — after all Update tests.

item.name: Post Comment - Spoofed Name Ignored
item.description: Sends `name: 'HACKER'` in the body. The server must ignore it and use the JWT name instead.

exec: pm.test('Name is from JWT not body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('testUserName')));

item.name: Post Comment - Second on Same Attraction
item.description: A second comment on paris_0 is allowed. No additional karma is awarded (deduplication guard).
